title: The Quiet Detention
author: O. M. Pemberton
blurb: Yara Fairweather, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide who to be when the labels come off before graduation.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
